claim: Victoria Palace Theatre is on the same side as a central London railway terminus.

arguments.text: Victoria Palace Theatre is situated on Victoria Street, directly opposite and on the same side of the thoroughfare block structure as London Victoria station, one of central London's major railway termini.

Victoria Palace Theatre is actually located on Victoria Street on the northern side, whereas London Victoria station's main terminus buildings and platforms are positioned across different intersecting blocks and streets (such as Terminus Place and Buckingham Palace Road), meaning they are not on the same side of the thoroughfare block structure as claimed.

London Victoria station and the Victoria Palace Theatre share the same continuous street frontage block bounded by Victoria Street, Cardinal Place, and Bressenden Place, placing them unequivocally on the same side of this central London thoroughfare.

The Victoria Palace Theatre sits on the corner of Victoria Street and Bressenden Place, while London Victoria station's terminus buildings occupy a completely separate footprint on Terminus Place and Buckingham Palace Road; they are separated by intervening roads and distinct city blocks, meaning they do not share a single continuous street frontage block.

claim: Bones is inspired by a real person.

arguments.text: The hit television series Bones is directly inspired by the life and career of forensic anthropologist and author Kathy Reichs, who served as a producer on the show and upon whose real-life experiences and novels the protagonist Temperance Brennan is based.

While Kathy Reichs shares a profession with the character, Temperance Brennan is a fictional construct with a completely different personality, background, and personal life, meaning the character is not inspired by a real person.

The skeptic's objection relies on an overly narrow definition of 'inspired by'; sharing a unique profession, career path, specific forensic techniques, and forming the very basis of the source novels' protagonist clearly demonstrates that Kathy Reichs is the real-world inspiration for the character.

Sharing a profession does not make a fictional character 'inspired by' a specific real person in any meaningful biographical sense, especially when the fictional character's name, biography, personality, and life events are entirely invented by the author.
